# elves_configuration (Resource)

Manages an Elves configuration: the Santa settings sent to every Mac using it, and the base for its rules (see `elves_config_rule`). New Macs start on the default configuration (ID 1), which is managed by Elves and can't be changed or imported. Deleting a configuration moves its Macs to the default configuration and removes its rule assignments; on their next sync the Macs get the default configuration's settings and rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "elves_configuration" "engineering" {
  name        = "Engineering"
  client_mode = "LOCKDOWN"
  sync_type   = "CLEAN_ALL"

  # USB storage read-only and not executable
  block_usb_mount  = true
  remount_usb_mode = "noexec,rdonly"
}

# Rules for that configuration
resource "elves_config_rule" "engineering_tools" {
  rule_id    = elves_rule.docker.id
  config_ids = [elves_configuration.engineering.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_mode` (String) Required. `MONITOR` only logs apps that would be blocked; `LOCKDOWN` blocks every app that no rule allows.
- `name` (String) Required. Name shown in Elves.

### Optional

- `allowed_path_regex` (String) Optional. Regex of paths that are always allowed, whatever the rules say. Empty (the default) for none.
- `batch_size` (Number) Optional. Number of rules sent per rule download request. Defaults to 50000.
- `block_usb_mount` (Boolean) Optional. Block mounting USB mass storage. Defaults to false.
- `blocked_path_regex` (String) Optional. Regex of paths that are always blocked, whatever the rules say. Empty (the default) for none.
- `enable_bundles` (Boolean) Optional. Let Santa hash whole app bundles, so a bundle can be approved at once. Defaults to true.
- `enable_transitive_rules` (Boolean) Optional. Allow binaries created by an `ALLOWLIST_COMPILER` rule. Defaults to false.
- `full_sync_interval` (Number) Optional. Seconds between full syncs. Defaults to 600.
- `override_file_access_action` (String) Optional. Override for file access rules: `NONE` uses them as written, `AUDIT_ONLY` only logs, `DISABLE` turns them off. Defaults to `NONE`.
- `remount_usb_mode` (String) Optional. Mount flags for USB storage when `block_usb_mount` is on, for example `noexec,rdonly` to allow it read-only. Empty (the default) blocks it entirely.
- `sync_type` (String) Optional. How Macs apply the rule list: `CLEAN_ALL` replaces all rules on every sync, `CLEAN` replaces the rules from the sync server, `NORMAL` only adds and changes rules (removed rules stay on the Mac until a clean sync). Defaults to `CLEAN_ALL`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the configuration in Elves, for example for `elves_config_rule`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A configuration can be imported by its ID. The default configuration (ID 1)
# can't be managed by Terraform.
terraform import elves_configuration.example 5
```
